name: Sub2API Video
author: cc2cx
description: Sub2API JSON video gateway with authenticated result downloads.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Verified Sub2API video model or alias.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Integer duration in seconds, constrained by the model capability.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Model resolution tier; Sub2API maps it to the workflow enum.

parameters.name: aspectRatio
parameters.description: 16:9 or 9:16; square output is not enabled.

parameters.name: images
parameters.description: Public reference URLs, first and last frame roles ordered before other references.

validations.message: Sub2API video model has no verified capability profile
This Sub2API video profile does not accept video or audio references
